title: Gypsumtools Black Friday 2025 Multi-Channel Campaign
briefDescription: Comprehensive Black Friday campaign spanning website, social media, email, and print—560+ products, 14-day execution.
description: Gypsumtools' biggest sale of the year needed a campaign that matched the scale—560+ discounted products across a 14-day window. We developed three creative concepts, produced assets for every channel, and delivered a cohesive campaign that drove their most successful Black Friday yet.
challenge: Black Friday in construction retail is competitive—every supplier is shouting discounts. Gypsumtools needed to stand out with their biggest sale ever: 560+ items discounted across 14 days including daily deals, general promotions, and a Cyber Monday extension. The campaign had to work across website banners, social media posts and stories, email marketing, and A1 in-store posters—all while maintaining their recently refreshed brand identity.
solution: We developed three distinct creative concepts—Industrial Impact, Precision Cuts, and Toolbox Takeover—each with unique visual approaches suited to construction professionals. After client review, we produced a complete asset suite: desktop and mobile website banners, social media posts in multiple formats, animated intro/outro videos, daily deal templates, email assets, and large-format print materials. Every piece maintained brand consistency while creating the urgency and excitement a major sale demands.
results: Complete multi-channel campaign delivered on schedule
Website banners for desktop (1920×527) and mobile (349×350)
Social media suite with multiple post formats and video content
Daily deal templates enabling rapid 14-day content production
A1 poster production for in-store impact
Email assets driving customer engagement throughout campaign
Cohesive visual identity across all 560+ product promotions

creativeRoutes.name: Industrial Impact
creativeRoutes.description: Bold, angular geometric shapes inspired by construction blueprints. Graphite grey backgrounds with high-contrast deep orange accents. Construction site digital countdown timer.

creativeRoutes.name: Precision Cuts
creativeRoutes.description: Minimalist approach with abundant white space and surgical precision in element placement. Clean shadows, organised information blocks. Animated slicing effects for digital reveals.

creativeRoutes.name: Toolbox Takeover
creativeRoutes.description: Layered, dimensional approach suggesting depth and organisation like a professional toolbox. Products lifting from compartments with interactive hover effects.

brandMessage: Major retail campaigns require both scale and consistency. When you're promoting 560+ products across 14 days and multiple channels, systematic thinking is what separates chaos from cohesion.
whatWeLearned: Black Friday campaigns for trade audiences need different energy than consumer retail. Construction professionals respond to clarity and value, not gimmicks. The winning approach combined professional credibility with genuine excitement about substantial savings.
